disclaimer: Decision support only. Review with local farmers and agriculture officers before acting.

why_suggested: This is the rotation assumed to be in use now. It is the baseline the others are compared with.
evidence: Rice (paddy): rain and stored soil water met 100% of crop water need in a typical year and 94% in a poor year (1 in 4); 0 of 45 seasons fell below 50%.
information_gaps: Rice water need here is crop evapotranspiration only. Puddling and percolation losses in paddy fields are not counted, so real water use is higher.
Soil water-holding capacity is assumed (100 mm), not measured for this location.
Crop season lengths come from FAO tables for other regions, not local varieties.
Market prices, input costs and yields are not included.
The current rotation and sowing dates are assumptions, not survey data.
risks_for_local_review: Results describe a grid cell of about 50 km, not an individual field.
Pests, diseases, seed availability and labour are not modelled.

why_suggested: It keeps the field covered for more of the year.
evidence: Rice (paddy): rain and stored soil water met 100% of crop water need in a typical year and 94% in a poor year (1 in 4); 0 of 45 seasons fell below 50%.
Green gram: rain and stored soil water met 19% of crop water need in a typical year and 10% in a poor year (1 in 4); 42 of 44 seasons fell below 50%.
benefits: About 3.3 fewer bare months a year, which reduces exposure of the soil to erosion.
Adds a legume, which fixes nitrogen from the air.
Alternating crop families interrupts pests and diseases that build up under one crop.
information_gaps: This result depends strongly on how much water the soil holds: the weakest crop gets 13% of its water need with 75 mm of soil storage and 51% with 200 mm. Local soil data is needed before relying on it.
Rice water need here is crop evapotranspiration only. Puddling and percolation losses in paddy fields are not counted, so real water use is higher.

risks_for_local_review: The weakest crop does worse in poor-rain years than the current rotation (10% against 94%).
Its crops need more water over the year (867 mm against 568 mm), because the field is cropped for longer.
Results describe a grid cell of about 50 km, not an individual field.
